name: LancerKarmaDice
title: Karma Dice for Lancer
summary: Breaks up long streaks of bad rolls so that the RNG feels less RNG
description: After a run of bad results, the next d20 is corrected upward. Who it applies to, what counts as bad, how it corrects, whether it may crit, and how long a run has to be are all settings on this page. Turn it off with the Enabled switch; no restart needed.

config_schema.title: Karmic Dice
config_schema.description: Changes take effect after Apply changes, at the start of the next combat. No restart needed.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Off: every roll is vanilla.

players_only.title: Players only
players_only.description: On: only your own mechs get karma. Off: everyone does, enemies included.

outcome_aware.title: Outcome-aware
outcome_aware.description: Off: a bad result is a low raw d20 (see Low roll threshold), on every d20 roll. On: a bad result is a MISSED ATTACK; saves and checks are ignored unless Mixed mode is on.

mixed_mode.title: Mixed mode
mixed_mode.description: Only matters when Outcome-aware is on: saves, checks and other non-attack d20s then use the low-roll rule and count toward the same run.

reroll_mode.title: Reroll instead of bonus
reroll_mode.description: Off: adds Strength to the die. On: rolls ONE extra d20 and keeps the higher (Strength is ignored).

allow_crits.title: Allow karma crits
allow_crits.description: Off: a corrected roll is capped at 19, so karma never manufactures a crit. On: it may reach 20.

kick_in.title: Kick-in
kick_in.description: How many bad results in a row before karma corrects the next roll. 1 to 20.

low_roll_threshold.title: Low roll threshold
low_roll_threshold.description: A raw d20 at or below this counts as bad (blind and mixed modes). 1 to 19.

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: Bonus added to the d20 once karma is active. 1 to 19. Ignored in reroll mode.
